title: doc: add summary comment to piv_sw_to_err() listing handled SW codes
description: wp11_proto_piv.c:225-234 -- piv_sw_to_err() maps specific PIV status words to error codes but has no comment listing which SW values it handles. A contributor adding SW handling must read the implementation. Add a header comment: list all SW values explicitly handled (69 82, 69 85, 6A 81, 6A 88) and note that all others fall through to WP11_PIV_ERR_SW. Per review rubric: this is a readability issue with engineering basis -- callers cannot distinguish expected from unexpected SWs without reading the body.
